senses.gloss: m. (a. contract. of ἀνδριάς‚—άντος) statue, also portable bust, image.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 3:2-5">Targ. Esth. III, 2—5</cite> (some ed. pl., incorr.).
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 24b:11">R. Hash. 24ᵇ</cite> a synagogue <he>דאוקימו בה א׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>הוה בה א׳</he>) in which they placed a bust (of a Persian king).
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 40b:14">Ab. Zar. 40ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳ של מלכים</he> royal (imperial) busts.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 25b:13">M. Kat. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>אתעקרו כל א׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>אתקציצו</he>) all royal statues were overthrown.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 3:1:6">Y. Ab. Zar. III, 42ᶜ</cite> top. [<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 8">Gen. R. s. 8</cite> <cite ref="A01373"><he>אינדרטין</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="A02127"><he>אַנְדְּרוֹנִיטִיס</he></cite>.]
